name: deep-code-review
description: Five-lane deep code and isolated GitHub PR reviews with Tracker context and Matt Pocock's checks.

interface.shortDescription: Deep code and isolated GitHub PR reviews.
interface.longDescription: Provides two workflows: deep review of local changes and isolated GitHub PR or branch review. Every non-trivial review runs five subagent lanes in 3+2 batches: Correctness, Integration, Resilience, Standards, and Spec. Both workflows use stable finding IDs and available Yandex Tracker context.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $deep-code-review for local changes, or $github-pr-worktree-review for a GitHub PR or remote branch.
